- redwood-integration-checklist.pdf (step-by-step SDK init, sample request, common errors)
- example-api-log-snippet.txt (how to read request_id tracebacks)
- link to API key rotation instructions: https://docs.redwood.inference/quickstart/api-keys

If you prefer a rebook, here are times I'm available next week (PT):
- Tue 10/20: 9:00–10:00, 14:00–16:00
- Wed 10/21: 11:00–13:00
- Thu 10/22: 08:30–10:30

Please let me know which slot works or send a calendar invite for an alternate time. If your engineering lead can't make it, I can do a focused 20-minute handoff just to exchange the sandbox API key and run one sample.

Hi Karthik — thanks for following up and for the checklist. Sorry we missed the slot — our eng lead was pulled into an incident.

We'd prefer an async first pass: can you confirm the exact SDK snippet for rotating API keys inside a VPC-restricted sandbox? Also, here's the failing call from our dev:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_XXX" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"small-optimizer","input":"hello"}'

Response header returned 401 with X-Request-ID: rwd_20261016_ab12c34

If you can look at that request ID and confirm whether it's a key mismatch vs an IP restriction, that would be ideal. If you need to send a time, we can do a short 20-minute slot next Tue 10/20 AM PT.

— Elena
CTO (acting)
Fintech Pulse

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@fintechpulse.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.inference, marissa.cole@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-10-18T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration office hours — missed handoff, next steps & async pack

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the trace and the heads up. I looked up request ID rwd_20261016_ab12c34 — that 401 is consistent with an IP allowlist on the key. Two options:

1) If your sandbox uses an egress IP list, add the Redwood sandbox egress range (we'll share a CIDR) to the allowlist and retry.
2) Rotate to a key scoped for "sandbox-unrestricted" (short TTL) for the exchange during the handoff — I can provision that if you confirm the trial admin email.

I attached the short integration checklist again and an example log snippet showing where to find the allowlist error. If you'd like the quick live handoff, I can do Tue 10/20 at 9:00 AM PT for a 20-minute focused session; otherwise pick any of the other slots I sent earlier.

Action items:
- Elena: confirm preferred approach (add CIDR or request temp key) and provide trial admin email if you want the temp key provisioned.
- Karthik: if Elena requests temp key, provision sandbox-unrestricted key with 24h TTL and share via secure notes.
- Ben/Marissa: log $200 trial credit on deal FP-2026-023 if Elena wants a follow-up call (Ben to confirm).

Thanks — happy to triage async if needed.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-integration-checklist.pdf, example-api-log-snippet.txt
